info.title: OpenAgentID Character API
info.description: Public, unauthenticated stateless deterministic agent decoration. Autos is the default rounded pill skin; SpaceX offers eight silhouette shapes. Skin controls body and face geometry; expressions and live-v1 eyes are shared across skins. This API neither mints identities nor verifies possession, ownership, lineage, revocation or permissions. No secrets, external assets, JavaScript, CSS or fonts. Every response including errors and 304 includes wildcard CORS; credentials are not required. Unknown and duplicate query parameters are rejected. Input, streamed body chunks and geometry are bounded; hosted infrastructure supplies request rate and duration limits. Runtime state resolves state.expression before status mapping, then outer preferred expression, then neutral. Status is presentation state only and establishes no agent activity or authority.
